content:
anita: Hey team, spotted a weird invoice line in the Feb monthly billing: `GPU_BURST_PREMIUM` for asia-southeast1 — ~12k. Not in our forecast. Anyone seen this before?

tom-infra: oof. not the exact tag but we saw unexpected surcharges last week for burst capacity in us-east. did you grab the raw line?

anita: pasted the snippet from the bill below:
```
LineItemId: 9876543210
Product: ComputeAccelerator
SKU: GPU_BURST_PREMIUM
Region: asia-southeast1
ResourceTag: gpu-pool-asia-01
Quantity: 720
Unit: minute
Amount: 12000.00 USD
Description: Burst capacity premium for accelerators above committed allocation
```

raj-eng: That `ResourceTag` is our autoscale pool. Quantity looks like minutes — 720 = 12 hours total. Wonder if an autoscale event spilled and we got premium for sustained burst.

lena-fin: We didn't have any alert for extra committed usage in Feb. Forecast vs actual shows commit covered baseline but not peaks. Has anyone changed reservation scope or labels recently?

billing-bot: Auto-detect: Similar SKU observed in provider feed 2026-02-12 -> region-level surge billing. Suggested action: open provider ticket + request usage breakout by instance id.

tom-infra: Action idea: provider sometimes applies a per-minute "burst premium" for capacity above reservation commitments. Two problems possible: 1) provider introduced a new SKU mid-billing period, 2) our reservations didn't cover instance-family/zone (mismatch). Either could create surprise line.

anita: I just ran a quick query against our cost export and saw the same SKU tagged twice for the same pool on adjacent lines (one for 7,200 minutes and one for 720 minutes) — total ~13200. That smells like either duplicate ingestion or misattributed refund/adjustment failure.

raj-eng: Can you paste the exporter rows? I want to check instance IDs and preemption events. If preemptions led to reboots across hours we might have billed both original and replacement.

anita: pasted rows (redacted):
`2026-02-12, gpu-pool-asia-01, GPU_BURST_PREMIUM, 720, minute, 12000`
`2026-02-12, gpu-pool-asia-01, GPU_BURST_PREMIUM, 7200, minute, 120000`

lena-fin: whoaaa that second line is 10x. we definitely don't have budget for that. tagging/aggregation bug?

tom-infra: Two quick checks: 1) Did our reservation commit apply to the correct SKU/family? (sometimes resumable reservations are zonal vs regional). 2) Did the provider change billing granularity (minute vs second) or retroactively re-rate lines?

anita: Opening a ticket now with provider support. Will request: per-instance breakdown, timeline of rating changes, justification for duplicate lines, and immediate credit for mis-bills. Ticket id: GCP-INC-4421 (link: https://provider.support/ticket/GCP-INC-4421)

billing-bot: Support ticket created by anita: GCP-INC-4421. Labels: invoice-anomaly, urgent, finance. Estimated SLA: 72h.

raj-eng: Meanwhile, I'll check infra side: audit autoscale logs for that pool between 2026-02-11 22:00 -> 2026-02-13 06:00. If we see replacement churn or stuck instances we might have accidental double-counting.

tom-infra: I'll also verify reservation allocations and the commit scope (zonal vs regional) and send a diff to @lena-fin. If provider insists on premium for minutes above commit, we should consider increasing reservation coverage for asia-southeast1 for predictable pricing.

lena-fin: Please add a quick cost impact note in the ticket: we need temporary credit if provider admits mis-tagging; else we need to approve reserves if it's legitimate.

anita: Provider responded with an initial acknowledgement and asked for the invoice lines + export CSV. Uploaded and asked for expedited review. They flagged a known backend bug where burst premium lines duplicated when a reservation and a transient preemption overlapped — they said it's under investigation.

raj-eng: Good find. If that's true then likely a provider-side duplicate. Keep an eye on the ticket for credit and a corrected invoice. Also we'll add a short-term guardrail: prevent autoscaler from cross-zone migrations during maintenance windows for that pool.

tom-infra: Also scheduling a postmortem runbook item: add an alert if any single SKU increases >250% month-over-month for a pool. That would've caught this earlier.

lena-fin: Thanks. Can you also add a dashboard widget showing `SKU | region | minutes | amount` so finance sees SKU spikes daily?

anita: Will add dashboard and follow up here once provider responds with remediation/credit. For now marking as `high` and tagging billing ops to hold any charge reconciliations for Feb until ticket resolves. :eyes:

billing-bot: Reminder set: delay auto-reconciliation for invoice 2026-02 until ticket GCP-INC-4421 resolved.

lena-fin: :raised_hands: appreciate the quick triage.

anita: Filing follow-up note: pending provider root cause; action items: (1) provider credit or corrected invoice, (2) infra guardrail + reservation check, (3) finance dashboard. I'll ping once we have provider resolution.

tom-infra: Thanks — keep us posted.

anita: End of thread for now.
